test_title: PYST 02: SSC JE ME - General Intelligence (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: JNHF is related to MQKI in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HLFD is related to KOIG. To which of the following is FJDB related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'JNHF' is related to 'MQKI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8efc1cf2a2e33b4402bcf02157df2a3882bf5534e4a9bcdd865d3c207745a298.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f91b330a2f0e7ffa6e4db72504e1a1fde2bc3770fcd97055a67e5d7318283d69.png] 

'HLFD' is related to 'KOIG'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf2c648e25d3401121f3f7a59c4d3ca7646d817c2b743a242f419929102d6cd7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/762ef48519b0a1f70dcd3b25d9da6435a61ba8a9a9b4f9e1a4b94cba400d901e.png] 

Similarly, for 'FJDB'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27d7917ba6c3077a7dd3231d04d7c2ab6598eac1bd04d0ffcea8b066cde50938.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24733a4c116f434f64288ca01312317f6aa388abc14e98eed06b760a975d58ef.png] 

So, 'FJDB' is related to '**IMGE**'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
